reason: Operationalize the preregistered source TCP and target-selection recalibration without changing the event, action grid, risk limit, query roles, or endpoint.
event_discreteness_note: With k=10, Recall@10 < 0.95 is equivalent to fewer than 10 exact hits; no continuous interpolation is used.

source_tcp_pool_rule.per_query_action: For each target seed and query role, find the smallest registered ef attaining Recall@10 >= 0.95 on each of the other nine old-snapshot builds, map failure at all rungs to ef=200, and take the maximum action across those nine source builds.
source_tcp_pool_rule.paired_seed_exclusion: The old build having the same seed as the target build is excluded from source pooling.
source_tcp_pool_rule.deployment_visibility: Only source-snapshot outcomes define the source action; refreshed-target outcomes are not used.

target_selection_recalibration_rule.rule: On the 500 target-selection queries of each target build, choose the smallest nonnegative grid-index shift applied to the frozen source per-query actions whose one-sided 95% Clopper-Pearson risk UCB is <= 0.05. If no shift qualifies, choose the endpoint action ef=200.
target_selection_recalibration_rule.application: Apply the single frozen build-level shift to that build's source-derived certification and cold-evaluation actions; clamp at ef=200.

certification_rule.acceptance: Accept a candidate on a target build only when its one-sided 95% Clopper-Pearson UCB is <= 0.05.
certification_rule.fallback: On rejection, deploy the separately evaluated ef=200 endpoint for that build.
certification_rule.endpoint_failure: If ef=200 itself has certification UCB > 0.05, mark the build NO_CERTIFIED_ACTION and do not substitute evaluation truth.

evaluation_rule: Cold evaluation is used once after actions, shifts, and certification decisions are frozen; it cannot alter deployment.

cost_rule.serving: Use native per-query distance computations from the deployed action.
cost_rule.source_profiling: Report old-snapshot source replay cost separately and do not silently charge it as target serving cost.
cost_rule.selection_and_certification: Report target selection and certification search costs separately from cold serving.
cost_rule.rebuild: Report rebuild cost symbolically if no harmonized native measurement is available.

statistics.interval: paired target-build bootstrap with within-build query resampling

claim_guardrails: No result may be described as safe when any deployed build lacks a certification UCB <= 0.05.
A positive result on only one dataset is conditional evidence.
The fixed endpoint is a safety fallback, not an adaptive-method win.
No action, shift, threshold, or fallback rule may be revised after aggregation.
